title: Harmonious Parameter Adaptation in Continual Visual Instruction Tuning for Safety-Aligned MLLMs
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The safety benchmarks (VLGuard, Ch3EF) measure general safety risks, including categories like Privacy, Risky Behavior, Deception, and Hateful Speech, without a specified focus on religious contexts.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
